title: Cleaned clauses have no repeated literals
statement: Let $\psi$ be a CNF formula over $n$ variables, and let $\mathrm{clean}(\psi)$ be the formula obtained from $\psi$ by discarding every tautological clause and then, in each surviving clause, keeping only the first literal on each variable. Then every clause of $\mathrm{clean}(\psi)$, viewed as a list of literals, contains no repeated literal.
hypotheses_covered: ψ is a CNF formula over n variables
replaced: Every clause of $\mathrm{cleanCNF\_D3}\,\psi$ has no duplicate literals.
